cards.name: The Fool
cards.description: The Fool shows a young, bright-eyed man stepping off the edge of a high cliff into the open air. He wears an ornate, colorful tunic and carries a small bindle or bag on a stick over his shoulder. In his other hand, he holds a white rose, showing innocence and purity. A small white dog leaps up at his heels, barking to warn him of the danger ahead. A bright yellow sun shines behind him, while rugged snow-capped mountains loom in the background.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.description: The Magician stands confidently behind a wooden table, one arm raised toward the sky holding a wand, the other pointing down to the earth. On the table before him lie the four suit symbols: a cup, a sword, a pentacle, and a wand. He wears a white robe with a red mantle, and an infinity symbol floats above his head. Red roses and white lilies grow at his feet, and a lush garden fills the background under a clear sky.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.description: The High Priestess sits serenely between two pillars—one black marked with the letter B, one white marked with the letter J—before a veil decorated with pomegranates. She wears flowing blue robes and a horned lunar crown, holding a partially concealed Torah scroll in her lap. A crescent moon rests at her feet, and the background is a deep blue expanse suggesting the night sky or water.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.description: The Empress reclines on a luxurious throne amid a lush, fertile landscape of wheat fields, a flowing river, and dense forest. She wears a crown of twelve stars and flowing white robes patterned with pomegranates. A heart-shaped shield bearing the symbol of Venus rests near her, and she holds a scepter topped with a globe. Soft cushions and pillows surround her, emphasizing abundance and natural growth.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.description: The Emperor sits upright on a massive stone throne decorated with ram heads, symbolizing Aries. He wears full red armor under a heavy cloak, a golden crown, and holds an ankh scepter in one hand and a golden orb in the other. Behind him rise stark, barren mountains under a clear sky, conveying structure, authority, and unyielding control.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.description: The Hierophant sits on a throne between two gray stone pillars, wearing elaborate papal vestments and a triple crown. He raises his right hand in a blessing gesture while holding a triple cross scepter in his left. Two tonsured monks kneel before him. At his feet lie two crossed keys, and the background is a formal, temple-like setting of stone and ritual.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.description: A naked man and woman stand beneath a radiant angel who spreads protective wings above them. The woman is positioned near the Tree of Knowledge with a serpent coiled around it; the man stands near a tree of flames. Behind them rise a mountain and a bright sun. The scene is set in an open, paradisiacal landscape under a clear blue sky.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.description: A crowned warrior in armored robes stands inside a stone chariot decorated with moons and stars. He holds a wand rather than reins, while two sphinxes—one black, one white—pull the chariot forward. Behind him are city walls and a flowing river under a starry canopy of blue and gold. His expression is determined and focused.

cards.name: Strength
cards.description: A serene woman in a white gown gently closes the jaws of a powerful lion with her bare hands. An infinity symbol floats above her head, and a garland of flowers crowns her. She stands in a calm landscape of green hills and a distant mountain under a clear sky, radiating quiet inner power rather than brute force.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.description: An elderly bearded man in a gray hooded cloak stands alone on a snowy mountain peak, holding a lantern that contains a glowing six-pointed star. In his other hand he grips a long staff. The background is barren and cold, emphasizing solitude, introspection, and the light of inner guidance against the darkness.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.description: A great golden wheel turns in the sky, inscribed with the letters TARO and alchemical symbols. On its rim climb a sphinx, a snake, and a jackal-headed figure. In the four corners of the card sit the winged creatures of Ezekiel—angel, eagle, lion, and bull—each holding an open book. Clouds swirl around the wheel against a blue sky.

cards.name: Justice
cards.description: A crowned figure sits between two stone pillars, holding a double-edged sword upright in one hand and golden scales in the other. She wears a red robe over green and a square golden crown. A purple curtain hangs behind her, and her expression is calm, impartial, and clear-eyed.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.description: A young man hangs upside down from a living wooden cross or T-shaped tree by one ankle, the other leg bent at the knee. His face is serene, and a golden halo of light surrounds his head. His arms are folded behind his back. The background is a muted landscape of hills and sky, conveying willing sacrifice and a shifted perspective.

cards.name: Death
cards.description: A skeletal figure in black armor rides a white horse across a barren field, carrying a black banner marked with a white five-petaled rose. In the foreground lie a fallen king, a kneeling child, and a praying bishop. In the distance a rising sun appears between two towers, while a river flows through the scene.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.description: A winged angel with a calm face stands with one foot on land and one in water, pouring liquid between two golden cups. On the angel’s forehead is a golden triangle within a square. A path leads from the pool toward distant mountains under a radiant crown of light. Irises grow at the water’s edge.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.description: A horned, bat-winged devil figure with a goat’s face and inverted pentagram on its forehead perches on a black pedestal. A naked man and woman stand chained by the neck to the pedestal, their tails ending in fire and fruit. The background is dark and smoky, emphasizing bondage, materialism, and shadow.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.description: A tall stone tower is struck by a jagged bolt of lightning from a dark, stormy sky. Flames burst from the upper windows and roof as two figures fall headlong from the structure. A crown is toppled from the top of the tower. The background is black and chaotic, filled with falling debris and fire.

cards.name: The Star
cards.description: A naked woman kneels at the edge of a pool, pouring water from two pitchers—one onto the land, one into the water. Above her shines a large eight-pointed star surrounded by seven smaller stars. An ibis stands in a tree in the background, and the landscape is calm under a clear night sky.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.description: A full moon with a solemn face shines between two towers. A path winds from a pool where a crayfish crawls onto land, past a howling dog and wolf, toward the distant mountains. Drops of light or dew fall from the moon. The scene is nocturnal, mysterious, and slightly unsettling.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.description: A radiant golden sun with a human face shines over a bright, open landscape. A naked child rides a white horse, holding a red banner, while sunflowers bloom along a low stone wall. The sky is clear and the mood is joyful, warm, and pure.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.description: A winged angel blows a golden trumpet from the clouds, an upright cross banner attached to it. Below, naked figures of men, women, and children rise from open coffins or graves with arms raised in response. Mountains and a body of water form the background under a gray sky.

cards.name: The World
cards.description: A dancing nude figure is wrapped in a flowing purple sash and holds two wands, enclosed within a large green laurel wreath. In the four corners appear the same four living creatures as on the Wheel of Fortune—angel, eagle, lion, and bull. The background is a clear sky of soft blues and whites, conveying completion and harmony.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud, firmly grasping a single wooden wand sprouting fresh green leaves. In the background stretch a fertile landscape of hills, a river, and a distant castle. The sky is clear, emphasizing pure creative potential and new beginnings in the element of fire.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.description: A man in a red robe stands on a castle battlement, holding a small globe in one hand while resting the other on a tall wand. A second wand is fixed to the wall beside him. He gazes out over a wide landscape of sea, hills, and distant mountains under a clear sky.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.description: A figure stands with his back to the viewer on a cliff overlooking the sea, three tall wands planted firmly in the ground beside him. Ships sail on the water below. He wears a cloak and looks outward toward distant horizons under a golden sky.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.description: Four tall wands form a celebratory arch decorated with flowers and fruit. In the foreground two women raise bouquets in greeting, while a festive crowd gathers near a castle in the background. The scene is bright, joyful, and filled with the sense of homecoming or celebration.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.description: Five young men brandish wooden wands in a chaotic, competitive melee. They appear to be sparring rather than fighting to the death, their movements energetic and somewhat playful. The background is an open field under a clear sky, conveying struggle, rivalry, and constructive conflict.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.description: A victorious rider on a white horse holds a wand topped with a laurel wreath while wearing another wreath on his head. A crowd of supporters walks alongside, holding their own wands aloft. The scene is a triumphant procession through a landscape of trees and hills.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.description: A determined man stands on higher ground, defending himself with a wand against six others thrusting upward from below. He wears mismatched boots and an expression of fierce resolve. The background shows a green hillside under a cloudy sky, emphasizing defense of position.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.description: Eight wooden wands fly through the air like arrows, all pointed downward toward the earth. Below them stretches a peaceful landscape of a river, hills, and a distant house under a clear blue sky. The image conveys swift movement, messages, and rapid progress.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.description: A weary but vigilant man leans on a wand, his head bandaged, while eight other wands stand upright behind him like a defensive barrier. He looks over his shoulder with cautious readiness. The background is a grayish landscape suggesting ongoing struggle and resilience.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.description: A man labors forward under the heavy burden of ten long wands carried across his back, obscuring his view. He walks toward a distant town or village. The sky is clear but the figure is bent with the weight of responsibility and overextension.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.description: A young figure stands in a desert landscape holding a tall sprouting wand and gazing at it with curiosity. He wears a yellow tunic decorated with salamanders and a red feathered hat. Behind him stretch barren dunes and distant mountains under a bright sky.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.description: A knight in armor decorated with salamanders charges forward on a rearing horse, holding a wand aloft. His cloak and the horse’s trappings are fiery red and yellow. The background is a desert landscape with pyramids, conveying passionate, impulsive energy.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.description: A queen sits on a throne decorated with lions, holding a flowering wand in one hand and a sunflower in the other. A black cat sits at her feet. She wears a crown and flowing robes, and the background is a bright desert landscape with clear sky, radiating confidence and warmth.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.description: A king sits on a throne adorned with lions and salamanders, holding a flowering wand. He wears a golden crown and red-and-yellow robes. A small salamander appears near his feet. The background is a clear desert sky, conveying leadership, vision, and fiery mastery.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud holding an ornate golden cup from which five streams of water flow into a lotus-filled pond below. A dove descends toward the cup carrying a wafer. Lilies float on the water, and the scene is framed by soft clouds against a clear sky.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.description: A young man and woman face each other, each holding a cup, their free hands almost touching. Above them floats the caduceus of Hermes topped by a lion’s head. The background is a gentle landscape of a house and hills under a clear sky, symbolizing partnership and mutual attraction.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.description: Three young women raise their cups in a joyful toast, dancing in a circle among abundant fruit and flowers. They wear flowing dresses of different colors and smile freely. The background is a fertile outdoor setting under a bright sky, celebrating friendship, community, and shared happiness.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.description: A young man sits cross-legged beneath a tree, arms folded, gazing at three cups on the ground before him with apparent disinterest. A divine hand offers a fourth cup from a cloud, which he does not notice. The background is a quiet landscape of hills and sky.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.description: A cloaked figure stands with head bowed, mourning three overturned cups whose contents spill onto the ground. Two cups remain upright behind him. In the background a bridge leads across a river toward a distant castle or town under a gray sky.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.description: A child in a white tunic offers a cup filled with white flowers to a smaller child. Four other flower-filled cups stand nearby. In the background are a cottage, a path, and a figure walking away. The scene is gentle and nostalgic under a soft sky.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.description: A silhouetted figure stands before seven cups floating in the clouds, each containing a different vision: a castle, jewels, a laurel wreath, a dragon, a serpent, a shrouded figure, and a human head. The cups are offered against a nebulous sky, representing choices and illusions.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.description: A cloaked figure walks away from eight carefully stacked cups, leaving them behind as he climbs toward a mountain range under a crescent moon. The landscape is barren and the figure’s posture suggests deliberate departure and emotional withdrawal.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.description: A contented man sits on a wooden bench with arms crossed, smiling with satisfaction. Behind him, nine golden cups are arranged in an arc on a draped table. He wears a red hat and colorful clothing, and the background is a simple interior wall, conveying emotional fulfillment.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.description: A happy couple stands with arms raised beneath a rainbow of ten golden cups. Two children dance nearby. In the background is a cozy house and green countryside under a bright sky, representing lasting emotional harmony and family joy.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.description: A young figure in a blue tunic decorated with fish stands by the sea, holding a cup from which a fish emerges. He looks at the fish with surprise and curiosity. Waves roll behind him under a soft sky, conveying emotional openness and intuitive messages.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.description: A knight in ornate armor rides a white horse at a gentle pace, holding a cup carefully before him. His helmet is winged, and the horse’s reins are decorated. The background is a calm river landscape with distant hills, suggesting romantic, idealistic movement.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.description: A serene queen sits on a throne decorated with water motifs and mermaids, holding an ornate closed cup. She gazes into it contemplatively. Behind her stretches a calm sea under a soft sky, conveying deep empathy, intuition, and emotional receptivity.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.description: A king sits on a stone throne floating on the sea, holding a cup in one hand and a short scepter in the other. He wears a blue tunic and golden crown. A ship sails in the distance and a fish leaps from the water, conveying emotional mastery and calm authority.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud grasping an upright double-edged sword crowned with a golden laurel wreath and palm branch. Six golden yods fall around the blade. The background is a stark mountain landscape under a clear sky, symbolizing pure mental clarity and breakthrough.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.description: A blindfolded woman sits on a stone seat, holding two crossed swords across her chest. Behind her stretches a calm sea under a crescent moon. The scene is still and tense, conveying difficult decisions, stalemate, and the need for inner balance.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.description: A large red heart is pierced by three swords against a backdrop of heavy gray rain clouds. The image is stark and emotional, with no human figures, emphasizing heartbreak, sorrow, and the pain of truth or separation.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.description: A knight lies in repose on a tomb inside a church, hands folded in prayer on his chest, three swords hanging on the wall above and one lying beneath him. A stained-glass window shows a scene of devotion. The atmosphere is quiet, restful, and contemplative.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.description: A smirking man gathers three swords while two defeated figures walk away with bowed heads, leaving their swords on the ground. Storm clouds gather over a choppy sea. The scene conveys hollow victory, conflict, and the aftermath of unfair advantage.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.description: A ferryman poles a small boat carrying a cloaked adult and a child across calm water toward a distant shore. Six swords stand upright in the boat. The sky is gray but the destination appears peaceful, suggesting transition and moving away from difficulty.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.description: A figure sneaks away from a military camp, carrying five swords while two remain stuck in the ground behind him. He looks back over his shoulder with a sly expression. Tents and flags appear in the background under a yellow sky, conveying stealth and strategy.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.description: A blindfolded woman stands bound and surrounded by eight upright swords stuck in the ground. She appears trapped, yet the bonds are loose and a path is visible. Behind her are a castle on a hill and a gray sky, conveying restriction that is partly self-imposed.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.description: A figure sits upright in bed, face buried in hands, under a dark tapestry decorated with roses and astrological symbols. Nine swords hang horizontally on the wall above. The scene is nocturnal and filled with anxiety, worry, and mental anguish.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.description: A figure lies face-down on the ground, pierced by ten swords along the spine. A black sky looms overhead, but a golden dawn breaks on the distant horizon over still water. The image is stark, conveying rock bottom and the end of a painful cycle.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.description: A young figure stands on a windy hill holding a sword upright with both hands, looking alertly over one shoulder. Clouds race across the sky and trees bend in the wind. The posture is ready and watchful, conveying mental agility and curiosity.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.description: A knight in full armor charges forward on a galloping white horse, sword raised high. His expression is fierce and determined. Storm clouds fill the sky and the landscape is windswept, conveying rapid, decisive, and sometimes reckless mental action.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.description: A stern queen sits on a stone throne decorated with butterflies and clouds, holding an upright sword in one hand while extending the other. She wears a crown and flowing robes. The sky is clear with a few clouds, conveying clear judgment, independence, and sharp intellect.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.description: A king sits upright on a stone throne carved with butterflies and moons, holding a sword upright. He wears a blue tunic and golden crown. Behind him are trees and a clear sky with a few clouds, conveying intellectual authority, truth, and decisive leadership.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud holding a large golden pentacle. Below, a lush garden path leads through an archway of flowers and greenery toward distant mountains. The scene is abundant and grounded, symbolizing new material opportunity and prosperity.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.description: A young man in a colorful tunic juggles two pentacles linked by an infinity loop while balancing on one foot. Ships sail on a choppy sea behind him. The sky is clear, conveying the need to balance multiple material or practical concerns with flexibility.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.description: A stonemason works on a cathedral arch while a monk and a noble figure look on and consult plans. Three pentacles are carved into the architecture above. The scene is collaborative and skilled, set inside a Gothic structure, emphasizing craftsmanship and teamwork.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.description: A crowned man sits rigidly on a stone seat, clutching a pentacle to his chest while two more rest under his feet and a fourth balances on his head. Behind him is a city skyline. His posture is closed and possessive, conveying control and material security.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.description: Two impoverished figures—one on crutches—walk barefoot through falling snow past a brightly lit stained-glass church window showing five pentacles. They appear cold and left out. The scene is wintry and bleak, emphasizing hardship and temporary exclusion.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.description: A wealthy merchant in fine clothes holds scales in one hand while dropping coins into the outstretched hands of a kneeling beggar. Another figure kneels nearby. Six pentacles appear in the scene. The background is a town square, conveying generosity, charity, and balanced giving.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.description: A farmer leans on his hoe, resting and surveying a bush heavy with seven golden pentacles. His posture suggests patient evaluation of progress. The background is a green field under a clear sky, conveying assessment of long-term effort and growth.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.description: A craftsman sits on a bench carefully engraving a pentacle, with seven finished ones displayed on a wooden post beside him. He is focused and diligent. The background shows a town and hills under a clear sky, emphasizing skill development and dedicated work.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.description: A refined woman in an elegant gown stands in a lush vineyard, one hand resting on a hooded falcon, the other near nine golden pentacles growing on the vines. A snail moves at her feet. The scene is peaceful and abundant, conveying self-sufficiency and refined enjoyment of wealth.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.description: An elderly man in a richly patterned robe sits with two dogs at his feet while a younger couple and a child stand nearby under an archway. Ten pentacles are arranged in the Tree of Life pattern across the card. A town is visible beyond the arch, conveying lasting family legacy and material security.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.description: A young figure stands in a green field holding a large golden pentacle with both hands, studying it intently. Flowers bloom at his feet and distant mountains rise under a clear sky. The posture is studious and grounded, conveying practical learning and new material opportunity.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.description: A knight in heavy armor sits solidly on a dark horse that stands still in a plowed field. He holds a pentacle before him and gazes at it steadily. The landscape is green and orderly under a clear sky, conveying methodical, reliable, and persistent effort.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.description: A queen sits on a throne decorated with fruit, goats, and angels, holding a large golden pentacle in her lap. A rabbit sits near her feet. Behind her is a lush garden and distant mountains under a clear sky, conveying nurturing abundance, practicality, and grounded care.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.description: A king sits on a throne carved with bulls and vines, holding a golden pentacle and a scepter. He wears a crown and richly embroidered robes. Grapes and greenery surround him, with a castle in the background under a clear sky, conveying material mastery, prosperity, and reliable leadership.
